in_english.long_meaning: Dulcelina is a Latin feminine name that means 'sweet' or 'beloved daughter'. It is derived from the Latin words (dulcis) 'sweet' and -(lena) 'daughter'. The name has been influenced by the classical tradition, as seen in (Proverbs 31:10-31), which emphasizes the importance of choosing a virtuous wife. The name is also associated with the qualities of a virtuous woman, as described in (Ephesians 5:22-33), (Philippians 4:8), (John 14:6), (1 Corinthians 13:13), (1 John 3:18), (Hebrews 11:6), (James 1:25), (1 Peter 3:8), and (Colossians 3:14).
